about.title: About Me
about.bio: My career started in web development and moved toward Machine Learning. At TikTok I saw up close how ML and large-scale data drive day-to-day operations, and that drew me to the challenge of understanding how those systems work.

expertise.title: What I can cover
expertise.body: Image classification with TensorFlow transfer learning and demand forecasting with Prophet, served through FastAPI and Docker, with Streamlit dashboards; the forecast runs on GCP Cloud Run. On the web side, CI with integration tests and continuous deployment on Vercel.

items.role: QA Analyst, Trust & Safety · previously Content Moderator
items.description: Content moderation, then quality analysis of moderation decisions at scale.
Building and shipping complete web applications for clients, from the database to the interface.

current.title: Right now
current.body: I'm building Nebluna Café, my roasted coffee brand. Nebluna Analytics came out of it: the demand forecasting system listed in the projects, built to solve a real problem in the business. Open to ML Engineer roles and to freelance ML or data projects, end to end.

contact.title: Get In Touch

assistant.title: Ask my portfolio
assistant.intro: Ask about the projects on this site and I'll answer from what's actually written here, with a link to the project I'm drawing on. If you'd rather talk to Fer, say so and I'll pass along your details.
assistant.disclaimer: Answers are generated with AI (Claude) from the projects on this site. Anything outside them, I'll say I don't know.
